in_hebrew.name: Georgette
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Georgette הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek, the name Georgette is derived from the name Georgia, meaning 'geography' or 'earth teacher'. This name holds rich historical significance, as Georgia was an ancient kingdom in the Caucasus region. In Christian tradition, it is believed that Saint George, the patron saint of farmers and shepherds, was born in the region of Georgia.
